narrative:
Mercer County has 29,019 registered voters, with 17.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 40.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 39.4%, a narrow Republican lean of 1.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.6% of registrants.
